## What are you trying to do

Describe the workload, contract, or workflow gap this would address.

## Proposed change

What should change, and where (`AGENTS.md` rule, a new/updated schema in
`schemas/`, a new doc under `docs/`, a script change, etc.)?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approach you considered and why this one is better.

## Impact on generated repos

Would this change behavior for repositories already generated from an
earlier template version? If so, note any migration steps.
